# Bumper post: a ten-sided candy-striped post r 0.3 m, 0.5 m tall (pink and white bands of
# 0.125 m), a yellow cap. Origin at the centre of its foot. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Post --base-color 1.0000 0.4235 0.4784 --no-slot
material new Stripe --base-color 0.9804 1.0000 0.9882 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 1.0000 0.9216 0.2000 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name P0 --vertices 10 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.125 --location 0 0 0.0625
material assign Post
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name P1 --vertices 10 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.125 --location 0 0 0.1875
material assign Stripe
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name P2 --vertices 10 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.125 --location 0 0 0.3125
material assign Post
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name P3 --vertices 10 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.125 --location 0 0 0.4375
material assign Stripe
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select P3
active P3
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Cap
mode object
select P0 P1 P2 P3
active P0
join
rename P0 Post
shade flat
export post.glb
